overview: Kidnappers force a young mother (Melissa George) to recover money stolen by her shady husband (Christian Campbell).
tagline: What she doesn't know could kill her.

A three-tiered story centered around drugs and organized crime, and focused on a young man who becomes a runner for a coke dealer.
